headline: Executive order gives two international offices in Bosnia and Kosovo the same US legal protections as other international organizations.
what_it_does: This order applies parts of the International Organizations Immunities Act to the Office of the High Representative in Bosnia and Herzegovina and the International Civilian Office in Kosovo. That law gives certain international bodies and their staff legal protections in the United States, such as some immunity from lawsuits and certain tax breaks. No summary was provided, so the exact protections granted are not detailed here.

who_it_affects.group: Office of the High Representative in Bosnia and Herzegovina
who_it_affects.how: The office gains certain legal protections and privileges under US law.
